answer: A raven-stamped census bond counts each agent once. An identity locks 70 credits, files one form for a reef plot, stamps it with a raven key. A beacon auditor replays the census each epoch: one plot with two forms, or a mismatched stamp, fails the census and burns the bond. A rented-plot ring loses its stake. Filing 40, then 40+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 2,537,500 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 40 once, refunded.
